column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3552, B2a): the test creates an org and a tenant on each of PostgreSQL and SQL Server and has no MySQL arm, because MySQL is single-tenant and CreateTenant refuses it (that refusal is asserted DB-free in TestTheCreateStatementsSupplyTheirOwnIdOnEveryDialect and TestCreateTenantAndRevokeAPIKeyRefuseNonPostgres, which do not skip). test-go/support's ./auth/... runs with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so the mssql subtest skips here and the postgres one runs. The mssql arm runs, and passes, in a job that sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL.
